simpleJp: 酒場のマスターに話す
jpGuide1: 1500G稼いだら酒場へ行ってマスターに話し掛ける。
jpGuide2: 酒場のマスターに話す→アパートへ移動→酒場へ移動
enGuide: Mandatory story resumes in Indigos immediately after the early optional block. Have 1500G, talk to the Indigos tavern master, rest in Shu's bed until the tavern closes, then return to the tavern and win the night battle. Only after this event should you travel back to Prodius.

jpGuide1: ひとまずプロディアスへ行く。
enGuide: Now travel from Indigos to Prodius. This is the next mandatory story destination after the night battle; you are not returning for optional cleanup.

simpleJp: ヒエン置き場でビビガから「チケット」を受け取る
jpGuide1: 改めてビビガに話し掛けて「チケット」をもらう。
jpGuide2: ビビガに話しかけて「チケット」回収
enGuide: After the night battle, travel to Prodius and go to the Hien storage area. Speak to Bibiga there and take the ceremony Ticket; this is the item that lets the mandatory ceremony sequence continue.

jpGuide1: イベントでヤゴス島へ。
enGuide: With the Ticket in hand, enter the ceremony venue in Prodius. This is a real progression lock: entering closes the first early guild-job window and sends the story to Yagos Island, so finish anything in the preceding optional block first.

simpleJp: ヤゴス島の封印の遺跡をB2Fまで進む
jpGuide1: B2Fまで進めばひとまずクリア。
enGuide: On the first Ruins visit, descend only to B2F; reaching B2F completes this pass. The deeper sealed route is handled on the second visit.

simpleJp: 封印の遺跡へ再入場する
jpGuide1: 最深部でパワーユニットを入手
enGuide: On the second visit, descend to the bottom. Gargoyle watcher statues can be rotated; taking watched treasure without turning them triggers battles. Collect the Power Unit at the deepest floor, then return to B2F to finish the objective.

simpleJp: ユドの村でベッドに休む
jpGuide1: 促される通りにベッドで休むとイベント発生。
enGuide: Rest in the bed when prompted to trigger the next event. Afterward, win the ninja battle; from this point Lieza can begin learning Ravish. After Yagos ends, follow the next section “ヤゴス島帰還〜ガルアーノの屋敷”; do not jump ahead to the White House jobs yet.
